info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Sensors API

items.docs: Retrieves the list of available sensors on the device. Each sensor type uses a GetDefault() static method to check availability. Supported types include Accelerometer, Gyrometer, Compass, Inclinometer, LightSensor, Barometer, Altimeter, Magnetometer, OrientationSensor, Pedometer, ProximitySensor, ActivitySensor, HumanPresenceSensor, and HingeAngleSensor.
